$comment: Controls optional FSCR pillar-skill selection while creating task context. A unique exact task-code-and-name skill is canonical and may be reused across Oracle offering and functional-area contexts; skill_selection records that relationship explicitly. Oracle task matching is unaffected.
$comment.include_missing_skill: When true, keep a catalog-matched task even when no pillar SKILL.md is found; its skill_path is null and Task Validation skips that task. When false, omit that task from Task Validator context.
$comment.multiple_skill_policy: SELECT_BY_PRIORITY chooses one candidate using priority_order. SELECT_LEXICOGRAPHIC_PATH always selects the alphabetically first path. FAIL stops task-context generation when more than one candidate exists.
$comment.priority_order: Applied from first to last only when multiple candidates remain. LEXICOGRAPHIC_PATH guarantees a deterministic final selection.
